review.method: Visual review of the silent benchmark source

steps.title: Convert the source video
steps.instruction: Run ffmpeg2theora on the source video and verify the Ogg output file.

steps.title: Upload the Ogg file
steps.instruction: Open the Commons upload wizard and select the converted Ogg file.

steps.title: Describe the upload
steps.instruction: Add the title, description, date, categories, and license.

steps.title: Insert the video
steps.instruction: Open the wiki source editor and add the uploaded video file.

steps.title: Verify the page
steps.instruction: Preview the page and verify that the video appears.
